contextFiles.noText: No extractable text for this file — open it in {{source}}.

create.copyIntro: The new project will start as a fresh <0>draft</0> with the same description, client and tasks (titles, hierarchy, estimates, labels, dependencies). Members, time entries and comments are not copied.
create.searchPlaceholder: Search by key, name or description…
create.introBillable: A billable project prepares a PMBOK charter, gets signed by the client, then activates.
create.introNonBillable: A non-billable project is for internal / organizational work. It skips the charter signature and is created as a draft you can activate whenever you're ready.
create.keyHint: — 2 or 3 chars, used as a colored badge on every card
create.keyCollision: Another project already uses <0>{{key}}</0>. Tasks will show the same prefix.
create.budgetPlaceholder: Budget envelope — editable later in the settings
create.budgetNotSaved: Project created, but budget not saved: {{message}}

expenses.confirmDeleteBody: This cost ({{amount}}) will be removed from the project budget.

offer.sendToClient: Send the offer to the client

offer.sentHint: Offer sent{{date}}. Waiting for the client's decision.
offer.resendTitle: Resend the offer by email to the client
offer.confirmEmailBody: The document <0>{{filename}}</0> will be sent as an attachment to <1>{{name}}</1> ({{email}}).

offer.refuseTitle: Did the client refuse the offer?

manage.agents.enable: Allow AI agents on this project
manage.agents.enableHint: When off, no AI agent can be assigned to or claim tasks in this project. Off by default.
manage.agents.contextHint: Read by agents before they work: what the project is about, where deliverables go, conventions, links. Required when agents are enabled.
manage.agents.contextPlaceholder: e.g. Internal documentation project. Deliverables go to SharePoint /IT/Docs. Follow the internal style guide. Reference repo: …
manage.agents.contextRequired: A brief is required to enable agents on this project.
manage.agents.guardrailsHint: What agents must NOT do here: boundaries, forbidden actions. Optional.
manage.agents.guardrailsPlaceholder: e.g. Do not touch production config. Cite sources, never invent data. Stay within /docs.
manage.agents.costBudgetHint: Total € cap for agent work on this project. Agents can't claim tasks here once reached. Empty = no cap.
manage.agents.verifCapsHint: Mechanical proof methods available on this project. Self-attestation and human review are always available; a required method not listed here escalates to human review.
manage.agents.stakesHint: How much is at risk if an agent gets it wrong. Inherited by every task of the project; drives the required proof level (stakes × agent trust).
manage.agents.verifModeHint: report_only: the gate only logs proof gaps (calibration). enforce: the gate blocks below the required floor, and an agent-validator approve auto-approves (sampled to human). Inherits the org default when unset.
manage.sponsor.badgeTitleOn: Sponsor — receives announcements and milestone/status updates. Click to remove the tag.
manage.sponsor.badgeTitleOff: Mark as sponsor — will receive announcements and milestone/status updates.
manage.sponsor.toggleFailed: Could not update the sponsor tag: {{message}}
manage.sponsor.eventsHint: Which events are emailed to this project's sponsors (members tagged “Sponsor” above). Announcements sent via the assistant always reach the selected audiences.
manage.sponsor.budgetNote: Budget alerts to sponsors are qualitative only (threshold crossed) — amounts stay behind finance permissions.
manage.agents.briefHint: Fill in only what the app cannot know. Reviewer, verification mode, stakes and language are added automatically.
manage.agents.brief.rolePlaceholder: e.g. you write the SCCM to Intune migration sheets from tickets and workshop notes, one sheet per application batch.
manage.agents.brief.outputConventionsPla: e.g. markdown, English, 2 pages max per sheet, a before/after table and a risks section. Always cite your sources.
manage.agents.brief.deliveryTargetPlaceh: e.g. put the document in the task deliverable (content field). Do not create a SharePoint page, do not send email.
manage.agents.brief.outOfScopePlaceholde: e.g. do not change any SCCM collection, do not contact end users, never invent a figure - ask in a comment instead.
manage.agents.freeNotesHint: Anything that does not fit the fields above. Rendered last in the composed brief.
manage.agents.previewHint: The exact context pack served to agents on this project - composed by the server.
manage.agents.previewStale: Showing the SAVED state - your unsaved edits are not reflected here.
manage.agents.previewTruncated: truncated, some documents are NOT sent to agents
documents.aiFolderOffAction: Stop exposing this folder to agents
documents.aiInheritedHint: Exposed through its folder - move it out to stop this.
manage.agents.previewCharterFiltered: Budget, stakeholders and risks are never sent to agents - they stay out of this pack.
manage.agents.ciReposHint: One repository per line (e.g. owner/repo). A ci_signed proof is only accepted when its signed CI build comes from one of these repositories — a green build from an unrelated repository can no longer pass a deliverable. Leave empty to keep the historical org-wide matching.
